accepted.sentence: Frames are commonly made from steel, aluminum alloys, or carbon-fiber composites, balancing durability, weight, and stiffness.
Curved mudguards mounted above the wheels help deflect water and grit away from the rider and frame.
An enclosed guard can cover the upper chain run, helping keep clothing clear of moving parts.
In many designs, an inflated inner tube sits inside the tire and holds air through a small valve.
A fold-down support leg props the machine upright when it is parked on level ground.
Small reflectors attached to the wheels or frame return light toward its source, improving visibility in darkness.
A handlebar-mounted bell uses a spring-loaded striker to produce a brief warning sound.
A metal or composite rack above the rear wheel provides a platform for securing bags or other cargo.
